\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{মাশুল} (māshul)}{মাশুল (māshul)}]{\bn{মাশুল} (māshul) — a fee; the price paid (for something)}

\label{lesson:BN-C540-mashul}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for to give up hope, then the Bengali for to get tangled up.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{মাশুল}}
\textbf{\bn{মাশুল}} — \emph{māshul} — \textquotedblleft{}a fee; the price paid (for something)\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{পার্সেলটা} \bn{ভারী} \bn{হলে} \bn{বেশি} \bn{মাশুল} \bn{লাগবে।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Pārselṭā bhārī hôle beshi māshul lāgbe.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
If the parcel is heavy, the fee will be higher.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{মাশুল}} (\emph{māshul}) is usually traced to Arabic \emph{maḥṣūl}, \textquotedblleft{}revenue, produce\textquotedblright{}, through Persian.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for saying what happens if.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{māshul}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{māshul}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{Pārselṭā bhārī hôle beshi māshul lāgbe.} — If the parcel is heavy, the fee will be higher.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for to give up hope, then the Bengali for to get tangled up, then say \emph{māshul} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \bn{মাশুল} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A fee; the price paid (for something)\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{খেসারত} (khesārôt)}{খেসারত (khesārôt)}]{\bn{খেসারত} (khesārôt) — the price of a mistake; a penalty}

\label{lesson:BN-C540-khesarot}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for to get tangled up, then the Bengali for a fee.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{খেসারত}}
\textbf{\bn{খেসারত}} — \emph{khesārôt} — \textquotedblleft{}the price of a mistake; a penalty\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{দেরিতে} \bn{রওনা} \bn{দেওয়ার} \bn{খেসারত} \bn{দিলাম}: \bn{ট্রেনটা} \bn{ছেড়ে} \bn{গেল।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Derite rôonā deoyār khesārôt dilām: ṭrenṭā chheṛe gelô.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
I paid the price for setting off late: the train left.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{খেসারত}} (\emph{khesārôt}) is usually traced to Arabic \emph{khasāra}, \textquotedblleft{}loss\textquotedblright{}, through Persian.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for saying what happens if.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{khesārôt}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{khesārôt}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{Derite rôonā deoyār khesārôt dilām: ṭrenṭā chheṛe gelô.} — I paid the price for setting off late: the train left.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for to get tangled up, then the Bengali for a fee, then say \emph{khesārôt} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \bn{খেসারত} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}The price of a mistake; a penalty\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{আশ্বাস} (āshvās)}{আশ্বাস (āshvās)}]{\bn{আশ্বাস} (āshvās) — reassurance; an assurance}

\label{lesson:BN-C540-ashvas}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for a fee, then the Bengali for the price of a mistake.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{আশ্বাস}}
\textbf{\bn{আশ্বাস}} — \emph{āshvās} — \textquotedblleft{}reassurance; an assurance\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{ডাক্তার} \bn{আমাদের} \bn{আশ্বাস} \bn{দিলেন।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Ḍāktār āmāder āshvās dilen.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
The doctor reassured us.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{আশ্বাস}} (\emph{āshvās}) is Sanskrit \emph{āśvāsa}, \textquotedblleft{}breathing again freely\textquotedblright{} (Monier-Williams): what lets you breathe easy.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for saying what happens if.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright

  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{āshvās}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{Ḍāktār āmāder āshvās dilen.} — The doctor reassured us.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for a fee, then the Bengali for the price of a mistake, then say \emph{āshvās} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \bn{আশ্বাস} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}Reassurance; an assurance\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.

\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{বর্ম} (bôrmô)}{বর্ম (bôrmô)}]{\bn{বর্ম} (bôrmô) — armour}

\label{lesson:BN-C540-bormo}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for the price of a mistake, then the Bengali for reassurance.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{বর্ম}}
\textbf{\bn{বর্ম}} — \emph{bôrmô} — \textquotedblleft{}armour\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{গল্পের} \bn{রাজা} \bn{একটা} \bn{ভারী} \bn{বর্ম} \bn{পরলেন।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Gôlper rājā ekṭā bhārī bôrmô pôrlen.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
The king in the story put on heavy armour.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{বর্ম}} (\emph{bôrmô}) is a tatsama, Sanskrit \emph{varman}, \textquotedblleft{}armour, a coat of mail\textquotedblright{} (Monier-Williams).
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for saying what happens if.
\end{grammarlens}

\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{bôrmô}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{bôrmô}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{Gôlper rājā ekṭā bhārī bôrmô pôrlen.} — The king in the story put on heavy armour.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for the price of a mistake, then the Bengali for reassurance, then say \emph{bôrmô} again
\end{itemize}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{চুকানো} (chukāno)}{চুকানো (chukāno)}]{\bn{চুকানো} (chukāno) — to settle; to finish off (a matter)}

\label{lesson:BN-C540-chukano}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for reassurance, then the Bengali for armour.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{চুকানো}}
\textbf{\bn{চুকানো}} — \emph{chukāno} — \textquotedblleft{}to settle; to finish off (a matter)\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{আমরা} \bn{ঝামেলাটা} \bn{আজই} \bn{চুকালাম।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Āmrā jhāmelāṭā āji chukālām.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
We settled the trouble that very day.
\end{quote}

Past (he/she …): \bn{তিনি} \bn{দোকানের} \bn{ধার} \bn{চুকালেন}, \emph{tini dokāner dhār chukālen}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{চুকানো}} (\emph{chukāno}) comes from a reconstructed \emph{cukk}, \textquotedblleft{}stop\textquotedblright{}; CDIAL lists Bengali \emph{cukāna}, \textquotedblleft{}to get rid of, to finish, to settle\textquotedblright{} (CDIAL 4848).
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for saying what happens if.
\end{grammarlens}

\raggedright

  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{chukāno}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{Āmrā jhāmelāṭā āji chukālām.} — We settled the trouble that very day.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for reassurance, then the Bengali for armour, then say \emph{chukāno} again
\end{itemize}
